self = <test_hba1c.TestHbA1cSection object at 0x7f0bf564f9e0>

    @pytest.mark.priority(10)
    @allure.title("Verify inline editing of HbA1c logs in the history table list")
    def test_10_edit_data_in_hba1c_section(self):
        self.hba1c_page.navigate_to_health_tab()
        self.page.locator(HbA1cPage.CARD_HEADER_HISTORY_BTN).click()
        self.page.locator(HbA1cPage.FILTER_LAST_YEAR_TAB).click()
        row_edit_buttons = self.page.locator(HbA1cPage.EDIT_ROW_BTN)
        count = row_edit_buttons.count()
        for idx in range(count):
            row_edit_buttons.nth(idx).click()
            input_el = self.page.locator(HbA1cPage.ROW_INPUT_FIELD).first
            input_el.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=5000)
            self.hba1c_page.clear_react_input(HbA1cPage.ROW_INPUT_FIELD)
            input_el.fill("10")
            self.page.locator(HbA1cPage.ROW_SAVE_BTN).first.click()
            expect(input_el).to_be_hidden(timeout=5000)
            self.page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        self.hba1c_page.close_popup_if_present()
